newsitem.title: USA: Texas power prices steady despite cooler weather.
newsitem.headline: Texas power prices steady despite cooler weather.

text.p: Spot electricity prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) held steady Thursday despite forcasts of cooler weather in most of the state beginning Friday and through the weekend, industry sources said.

"I don't expect (the cooler weather) will push the prices lower, but I don't think there will be much in the way of sales," said one ERCOT marketer, adding "people right now just don't need any energy."

Although temperatures in southern Texas were expected to reach above 90 degrees Fahrenheit today, a cool front was forecast to cap daytime highs below 80 degrees through much of the state beginning Friday.
On-peak ERCOT power for Friday delivery of a 16 hour block was talked steady in the $19.60-20.60 range, the brokers and marketers said.
Off-peak next-day power was pegged steady in the $13.25-14.00 range, the sources said.
October on-peak ERCOT power was pegged in the $17.75-18.75 area, the sources said.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
